plainLanguage: Section 139A — Repealed. Kifungu hiki kimefutwa katika R.E. 2022.
meaning: Section 139A is expressly repealed and does not create a current substantive offence in this edition.
keyPoints: The section is expressly marked repealed.
Do not treat it as creating a current offence.

history.summary: Section 139A appears in Chapter XV — Offences Against Morality — Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Verified against the official R.E. 2022 government publication.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Liability should follow the express statutory ingredients rather than assumptions based on the heading.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Age thresholds, consent, knowledge, intention and express defences require separate proof and analysis where applicable.

debateQuestion: Je, facts na evidence zinatimiza masharti yote ya section 139A?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
